title: Residential Electricity Supply Account Servicing Limits and Timing
content:
Care desk reference for Residential Electricity Supply. This table states, for each plan, how far back a billed line may be corrected, the largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one billed line, whether a mid-term plan change is permitted, and when a plan change and a cancellation drop take effect.

| Plan | Billing correction lookback (calendar months before the dispute date) | Care agent adjustment limit per billed line (USD) | Mid-term plan change permitted | Plan change takes effect | Cancellation drop takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge Monthly Variable | 12 | 150.00 | yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 6 | 12 | 150.00 | yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 12 | 12 | 150.00 | yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Price Lock 24 | 12 | 150.00 | yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Free Nights 12 | 12 | 150.00 | yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 12 | 12 | 150.00 | yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |
| Beacon Ridge Clean Wind 24 | 12 | 150.00 | yes | start of the next billing cycle | next scheduled meter read |

**Notes on the limits.**

- The care agent adjustment limit is 150.00 USD per billed line on every plan; larger corrections go to billing review.
- On every plan the customer may move to another Beacon Ridge residential electricity plan before the term ends.
- The billing correction lookback is 12 calendar months on every plan.
